Question: assalam u alaikum I would like to know the ta'bir of the dream i often use to see,that i lose my lower frontal teeth and i get very worried about it in the dream.alhumdulilla i offer five times salah with tahjud oftenly i get the chance..moreover i mostly sleep bawudu..hope your reply soon.jazakallh Answer ID: 9826 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2408/2132=D/1429) The dreams are not effective in themselves. Sometimes, dreams are inspired from satan . Recite the below dua thrice whenever you see such dreams: أ عوذ باللہ من الشیطان وشر ھذہ الر ؤ یا And then spit thrice to the left side and change the side you slept on. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
